scope: End-to-end FCO / Fe / Sonatina dependency structure distilled from bundle discussion
principles: Milestone names are release-cut views, not dependency authorities.
Nodes represent capabilities, invariants, tests, decisions, or uncertain zones.
Hard edges participate in topological sort; soft edges mark uncertainty/clarification overlays.
Every status must be audited against the current repo before implementation.
This graph is deliberately status-light: it is a draft dependency structure, not a completion report.

edge_kinds.soft: Uncertainty or clarification edge; useful for planning but not a topo-sort blocker.

nodes.title: Canonical dependency graph format
nodes.description: Canonical JSON/YAML schema for nodes, edges, edge kinds, release-cut views, acceptance tests, and repo evidence.

nodes.title: Topo sort and ready-frontier tool
nodes.description: Tooling to validate the DAG, detect cycles, and list ready nodes based on actual status.

nodes.title: Mermaid generator
nodes.description: Generated Mermaid diagram for human and agent communication.

nodes.title: Graph-driven agent prompt generator
nodes.description: Create compact implementor prompts from selected graph nodes and their acceptance criteria.

nodes.title: Fixture / acceptance matrix tracker
nodes.description: Track which fixtures prove which invariants and which nodes they satisfy.

nodes.title: Graph validation in CI
nodes.description: Optional CI check that validates graph shape, unknown nodes, and cycles.

nodes.title: Repo capability audit per run
nodes.description: Each agent first classifies actual repo capability rather than inheriting stale status.

nodes.title: Release cuts as graph views
nodes.description: M5/M6/M7 become named views over graph nodes, not dependency authorities.

nodes.title: Ready-frontier based agent handoff
nodes.description: Agents work from ready graph nodes whose dependencies are satisfied.

nodes.title: Status updates attached to graph nodes
nodes.description: After each implementation pass, node status/evidence is updated in the graph.

nodes.title: Evidence schema core
nodes.description: Structured evidence records contain goal, route, origin, premises/dependencies, and payload/fingerprint hooks.

nodes.title: Const term language core
nodes.description: Term nodes, interning, weak deterministic normalization, and internal term-language versioning.

nodes.title: Symbolic AssocConst as neutral term
nodes.description: Represent T::SIZE, B::WORD_BITS, Self::WIDTH as neutral const terms before concrete resolution.

nodes.title: Where const predicate parse/lower
nodes.description: Surface const predicates in where clauses parse, lower, preserve spans/origins, and enter semantic data.

nodes.title: Shared deferred obligation queue
nodes.description: Trait and const-predicate obligations can be carried through one deferred checking/discharge queue.

nodes.title: CTFE discharge outside trait solver
nodes.description: Const predicate evaluation happens at obligation/discharge layer, never inside proof forest / trait selection.

nodes.title: Call-site const-predicate discharge spine
nodes.description: Concrete function calls discharge callee where const predicates by CTFE/assumption routes and record evidence.

nodes.title: Paired correctness fixture suite
nodes.description: Positive/negative fixtures prove call-site discharge, diagnostics, evidence, no stale reuse, and no ICE categories.

nodes.title: WhereClauseOwner coverage
nodes.description: Inventory which owners can structurally carry where clauses: functions, structs/enums, impls, methods, etc.

nodes.title: Type-use WF surface inventory
nodes.description: Inventory all places where type well-formedness is required: construction, annotations, params, returns, fields, signatures.

nodes.title: ADT/signature/WF const-predicate discharge
nodes.description: Concrete type/ADT uses whose own where const predicates are false fail at every WF surface.

nodes.title: WF evidence origins
nodes.description: Positive WF discharges record evidence keyed to type-use / signature / construction origin, not just call expression.

nodes.title: WF duplicate diagnostic guard
nodes.description: Centralize or dedupe WF diagnostics when item-level and body-level checks see the same type use.

nodes.title: Generic symbolic WF guard
nodes.description: Symbolic generic type uses are not falsely CTFE-rejected; they are carried as assumptions/residuals until matched.

nodes.title: Never-called declaration/signature coverage
nodes.description: Impossible signatures and item fields fail even when no function body or call site exercises them.

nodes.title: Const predicates enter assumption pool
nodes.description: Caller / declaration where const predicates are collected as assumptions alongside trait constraints.

nodes.title: Assumption-route exact term matching
nodes.description: Symbolic const obligations discharge only by exact normalized term identity against in-scope assumptions.

nodes.title: Assumption evidence and premise origin
nodes.description: Assumption-route discharge records evidence linking the obligation to the caller/declaration assumption.

nodes.title: No splitting / flipping / implication tests
nodes.description: Fixtures prove no boolean splitting, no comparison-direction flipping, and no implication solver in the M5/M6 core.

nodes.title: Impl where const predicates represented
nodes.description: Impls can carry const-predicate where clauses as obligations/residuals.

nodes.title: Trait solver residual predicate carry
nodes.description: Trait selection returns selected impl plus residual const predicates instead of evaluating them inside the solver.

nodes.title: Gate-not-select semantics
nodes.description: Const predicates gate selected candidates after selection; they do not select among impls.

nodes.title: B2b overlap/coherence fixture
nodes.description: Two impls differing only by const predicate overlap or are rejected; no predicate-based specialization.

nodes.title: Selected impl predicate fault hard error
nodes.description: A false/faulting residual predicate is a hard diagnostic, not candidate removal or fallback.

nodes.title: Diagnostic taxonomy policy
nodes.description: Decide and document error classes for false predicate, formation failure, unsupported form, and CTFE fault.

nodes.title: False predicate diagnostic
nodes.description: A formed predicate that evaluates false reports the agreed predicate-not-satisfied diagnostic.

nodes.title: Formation / availability diagnostic
nodes.description: Missing associated const, unavailable trait source, or unformed predicate reports a formation/name diagnostic, not false predicate.

nodes.title: Unsupported projection/expression named limitation
nodes.description: Recognized but intentionally unsupported forms fail with a named no-ICE limitation diagnostic.

nodes.title: CTFE fault diagnostic
nodes.description: Evaluation faults, such as division by zero, are hard CTFE diagnostics, not unsatisfied predicate and not SFINAE.

nodes.title: Actual-value diagnostic rendering
nodes.description: When possible, diagnostics show substituted/evaluated values such as 16 != 256.

nodes.title: Receipt/debug evidence sink
nodes.description: At least one debug or test-visible consumer exposes discharged const predicate evidence.

nodes.title: LSP hover or fe explain seed
nodes.description: Human-facing surface renders goal, route, origin, substitution, and premises.

nodes.title: Explain chain with origins/premises
nodes.description: Explain mode traces from use site through assumptions/providers/premises to discharge route.

nodes.title: End-to-end draft acceptance harness
nodes.description: A coherent demo harness proves backend/platform facts flow through obligations, evidence, diagnostics, and lowering gates.

nodes.title: Release-cut view over graph
nodes.description: A named release cut, such as M5-finish, is a selected subset of graph nodes, not the primary dependency structure.

nodes.title: HKT / assoc-const ICE repro and fix
nodes.description: Track and fix known HKT-bound associated-const ICE path before richer projection evaluation depends on it.

nodes.title: Canonical associated-const projection identity
nodes.description: AssocConst identity moves toward subject TyId + canonical trait instantiation/args + assoc const def-id.

nodes.title: Term identity migration / invalidation
nodes.description: Bump TERM_LANG_VERSION or equivalent, invalidate stale evidence/caches, and document identity migration semantics.

nodes.title: AssocConst projection depth policy
nodes.description: Decide which projection forms are supported now, named-limited, or deferred.

nodes.title: Chained assoc-type / assoc-const projection support
nodes.description: Support forms like B::Memory::ADDRESS_SPACE or reject them with a principled limitation until ready.

nodes.title: Generic-trait assoc-const identity fixtures
nodes.description: Fixtures prove <T as Tr<A>>::C and <T as Tr<B>>::C stay distinct.

nodes.title: const_assert surface / VcSite
nodes.description: Introduce or verify a body-level const_assert / VC site representation.

nodes.title: Body assertion obligations
nodes.description: Body assertions produce obligations that use the same term/discharge/evidence path.

nodes.title: Body assertion receipts
nodes.description: Successful const_assert discharges record receipts; failures produce hard diagnostics.

nodes.title: VC site origin model
nodes.description: Body assertions have stable origins usable by diagnostics, explain, and future SMT.

nodes.title: Method const-predicate conformance semantics
nodes.description: Decide exactness/variance rules for method where const predicates absent general implication.

nodes.title: Method conformance queue routing
nodes.description: Method signature comparison routes const-predicate obligations through queue/evidence rather than trait-only comparison.

nodes.title: Method conformance evidence origin
nodes.description: Diagnostics/evidence identify trait method, impl method, and mismatched/missing predicates.

nodes.title: Full ConstraintKind refactor decision
nodes.description: Decide whether/when to replace trait-only predicate lists with a full ConstraintKind::Trait/ConstPredicate structure.

nodes.title: Trait predicates as projection
nodes.description: Trait-specific consumers read a projection/view from a unified constraint list.

nodes.title: Unified constraints across all surfaces
nodes.description: Calls, WF, impls, methods, providers, and assumptions use one constraint substrate.

nodes.title: Provider capability current-state audit
nodes.description: Audit whether Reflect, ImplBuilder, Evidence, Quote already exist as typed compile-time-only capabilities or remain string-keyed affordances.

nodes.title: Provider capability compile-time-only invariants
nodes.description: Capabilities cannot be constructed by ordinary user code, stored at runtime, or escape codegen.

nodes.title: Provider capabilities as FCO provisions/evidence
nodes.description: Capability grants are checked through FCO provision/evidence machinery rather than ad hoc keys.

nodes.title: Retire string-keyed authority checks
nodes.description: Reduce or eliminate REFLECT_KEY / IMPL_BUILDER_KEY style authority and derive-provider exemptions where safe.

nodes.title: Provider body / quote / reflection typing boundary
nodes.description: Clarify what provider bodies are typed by the normal compiler versus executor-only checks.

nodes.title: Generated impl provenance evidence
nodes.description: Generated impls record derive/provider origin and required/discharged obligations.

nodes.title: ABI/layout fact traits
nodes.description: Model generated-code preconditions as facts such as IS_DYNAMIC, HEAD_WORDS, field count, and layout class.

nodes.title: ABI/static-layout provider rewrite
nodes.description: First high-level generator rewritten or shadowed in Fe using provider capabilities and const-predicate evidence.

nodes.title: Event/error/msg provider rewrite
nodes.description: Move Rust-hardcoded event/error/msg lowering toward Fe providers after ABI/static shape is proven.

nodes.title: EIP-712 / Hash712 provider rewrite
nodes.description: Use evidence-backed layout/field facts to generate and explain hash/EIP-712 code.

nodes.title: Core derives FCO integration
nodes.description: Generic derive providers consume/produce FCO obligations/evidence rather than parallel derive logic.

nodes.title: Generated code through normal HIR obligations
nodes.description: Provider-generated code type-checks and discharges obligations through the same pipeline as handwritten Fe.

nodes.title: Sonatina + multi-backend pressure note
nodes.description: Record that Fe platform facts and Sonatina v2 resource modeling are north-star use cases for FCO.

nodes.title: Platform/HKT trait prototype
nodes.description: Backend/platform abstraction traits expose Word, Ptr<T>, Storage<T>, and associated const facts.

nodes.title: Backend fact obligations
nodes.description: Platform facts such as WORD_BITS, HAS_STORAGE, ADDRESS_WIDTH enter the FCO obligation path.

nodes.title: Typed platform intrinsic capabilities
nodes.description: Low-level intrinsics are guarded by platform capability types/obligations rather than ad hoc lowering assumptions.

nodes.title: Backend-generic demo fixtures
nodes.description: Fixtures demonstrate EVM-like, pure-memory, tiny-word, and crypto/ABI platform facts.

nodes.title: Lowering gated by evidence
nodes.description: Backend-specific lowering proceeds only after relevant source-level obligations are discharged or carried.

nodes.title: merge_runtime_class risk ledger
nodes.description: Document latent order-dependent runtime-class merge behavior and its current reachability status.

nodes.title: Runtime-class reachability repro fixture
nodes.description: Construct or rule out concrete Fe repros for storage/calldata/transient merge families.

nodes.title: Interim runtime-class materialization/error policy
nodes.description: If reachable before Sonatina v2, decide deterministic/materialize/error behavior for cross-resource joins.

nodes.title: Sonatina v2 VSDG value/state model
nodes.description: VSDG explicitly models value/state dependencies instead of hiding them in ad hoc carrier merges.

nodes.title: Separation-logic resource proposition language
nodes.description: Resource propositions model ownership, frames, regions, disjointness, reads/writes, and backend storage classes.

nodes.title: Resource proof evidence with non-empty premises
nodes.description: Resource facts produce evidence whose premises close over frame/resource assumptions.

nodes.title: Cross-resource joins proven/materialized/rejected
nodes.description: Resource joins are explicit and safe rather than order-dependent.

nodes.title: merge_runtime_class supersession
nodes.description: Old runtime-class reconciliation shrinks or is replaced by VSDG/resource semantics.

nodes.title: VC / SMT goal classification
nodes.description: Classify which obligations can be discharged by exact match, CTFE, SMT, or future resource proof.

nodes.title: SMT discharge backend interface
nodes.description: Add a solver-backed discharge route that consumes terms, emits evidence, and keeps CTFE out of solver selection.

nodes.title: Premise closure / proof dependency graph
nodes.description: Evidence records non-empty premises and dependency closure for proof-producing routes.

nodes.title: Certificate/evidence serialization
nodes.description: Durable certificates/fingerprints are tied to term/resource language versions and premise closure.

nodes.title: Law systems / proof transport
nodes.description: Transport proof/law artifacts across generated code, backends, and sessions.

nodes.title: Unchecked arithmetic replacement policy
nodes.description: Distinguish compile-time layout facts from runtime pointer/range safety before replacing unchecked annotations.

nodes.title: Check elision from evidence
nodes.description: Use evidence/premises to safely elide checks only when source, resource, and runtime facts justify it.

nodes.title: Scope-indexed provision environment design
nodes.description: Unify traits, capabilities, generated impls, effects, and const assumptions as provision sources.

nodes.title: Trait/env assumptions as provisions
nodes.description: Trait impls and where assumptions become one class of scope-indexed provisions.

nodes.title: Effects/capabilities as obligations
nodes.description: Effect and capability requirements are expressed as obligations/provisions with evidence.

nodes.title: Generated impl overlays as provisions
nodes.description: Provider-generated impls enter scope as evidence-backed provisions.

nodes.title: Provider capabilities in provision environment
nodes.description: Provider capability grants are provided/resolved through the same environment model.

nodes.title: Const predicate assumptions as provisions
nodes.description: In-scope const-predicate assumptions are represented as provisions for exact-match discharge.

nodes.title: Stable explain across provision routes
nodes.description: Explain can traverse trait, const, provider, capability, effect, and resource evidence uniformly.

nodes.title: Unclassified current repo status
nodes.description: Every node needs actual repo classification before implementation.

nodes.title: Diagnostic code policy mismatch
nodes.description: Old exit docs and live codes may differ; resolve by updating docs or implementation.

nodes.title: Provider capability current-state ambiguity
nodes.description: Capabilities may already be typed; audit before planning to add them.

nodes.title: Full ConstraintKind refactor necessity
nodes.description: Need decide if obligation-queue unification is enough or full ConstraintKind is required for future surfaces.

nodes.title: AssocConst projection depth boundary
nodes.description: Decide which projection shapes to support now versus name-limit.

nodes.title: HKT expressibility boundary
nodes.description: Current Fe/HKT syntax and lowering may limit platform/assoc-const fixtures.

nodes.title: Sonatina v2 sequencing
nodes.description: Clarify which Sonatina v2 concepts must shape FCO now versus wait.

nodes.title: SMT trust model
nodes.description: Decide how solver results are trusted, checked, cached, or certificate-backed.

nodes.title: Method exactness/variance policy
nodes.description: Decide how method const predicates compare without implication solver.

nodes.title: Runtime-class reachability
nodes.description: Determine if merge_runtime_class flaw is reachable in current source language.

nodes.title: Evidence format stability policy
nodes.description: Decide when evidence/term/resource formats are cache-only versus durable compatibility surfaces.

nodes.title: Kinded obligations/evidence north star
nodes.description: The original project impetus, tracked explicitly: kinds become able to express obligation-bearing domains and evidence/proposition-bearing codomains (Derive : * -> Constraint; A<B> -> *; * -> A<B>). G1 'demand=obligation, result=evidence' lifted to the kind level.
notes: Do NOT pull implementation into the M5 finish; this node tracks the telos so consolidation/refactors can answer how they preserve it.

nodes.title: No-accept-and-ignore diagnostics for planned kind forms
nodes.description: Forms such as A<B> -> *, * -> A<B>, and * -> Constraint are rejected by a named 'planned, not yet supported' diagnostic until supported; no silent Kind::Any fallback. Targeted safety rule, NOT a broad Kind::Any removal (Any still serves error recovery).
acceptance: A<B> -> *, * -> A<B>, * -> Constraint each emit a named diagnostic
no ICE, no Kind::Any silent acceptance, no nonsense lowering
notes: near-term; may proceed if cheap and it does not displace the M5 gate tail

nodes.title: Constraint kind design
nodes.description: Add a Constraint/proposition kind alongside Star and Abs; define kind checking and erasure boundaries.
notes: do not implement before M5 semantic closure unless architect reorders the draft

nodes.title: Traits as * -> Constraint
nodes.description: Traits become kinded constructors from types to constraints/propositions (n-ary as * -> ... -> Constraint), making Eq<T> a real kinded application.

nodes.title: Derive bridge graduation
nodes.description: Re-express Derive, Evidence, ImplBuilder, and require-like mechanisms as ordinary kinded constructs rather than provider-special-cased bridge machinery (today Derive is a compiler-known marker; Eq<T> in Evidence<Eq<T>> is special-cased).

nodes.title: Kind domains carry obligations (A<B> -> *)
nodes.description: Support domain-side kind bounds such as A<B> -> * once the obligation/provision substrate can represent them.

nodes.title: Kind codomains carry evidence (* -> A<B>)
nodes.description: Support evidence/proposition-bearing codomains such as * -> A<B> or * -> Constraint.

nodes.title: Provider bridge-drift cleanup
nodes.description: Quantify and repair bridge drift before graduation: provider/builder execution leaking into solving (B2), generated items not re-entering validation below type-checking (B1), reflection receiver binding by ident string, string-keyed capability authority.
acceptance: bridge-drift inventory with file refs for each of: solving-leak, sub-typecheck validation gap, ident-string reflection, string-keyed authority
notes: actual prerequisite pressure for graduating the bridge (std-lib provider polish is NOT)

nodes.title: Kinded evidence/provision integration
nodes.description: Connect kinded constraints/evidence to the scope-indexed provision environment and durable evidence model.
